topic: Massage for golfers' backs and hips

slides.headline: Back tight after 18 holes?
slides.sub: Where remedial massage can fit in a golfer's week.

slides.title: What a round asks of you
slides.body: Range balls and on-course swings, plus walking hills and bending for the ball, all load the lower back, hips and mid-back. Some tightness the next day is common for social golfers.

slides.title: What massage can help with
slides.body: Many golfers find massage around the hips, glutes and lower back eases stiffness and makes turning feel more comfortable. It complements strength and mobility work rather than replacing it.

slides.title: Timing around your round
slides.body: Lighter work the day before a round tends to suit most people. Deeper work usually sits better a few days out, or on the day after golf.

slides.title: Warm up before the first tee
slides.body: Five minutes of hip swings, gentle trunk turns and a few half swings with a short iron prepares your back and hips far more than going straight to driver.

slides.title: When to see a physio
slides.body: Back pain spreading into the leg, pins and needles, or pain on the inside of the elbow that keeps returning is worth a physio assessment. Our team can refer you across.

slides.headline: Want an easier turn?
slides.body: Our remedial massage therapists work through your back, hips and glutes to help you recover between rounds. Book online — link in bio.

caption:
Great round, stiff back the next morning? Sound familiar? ⛳

Golf asks your lower back, hips and mid-back to turn hard, again and again, on top of walking and bending. Many golfers find remedial massage helps those areas feel looser and makes rotation more comfortable.

Massage works alongside strength and mobility work rather than replacing it. Keep deeper sessions a few days out from a round, and warm up with hip swings, trunk turns and a few half swings before the first tee. Back pain spreading into the leg or pins and needles is worth a physio assessment.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physiotherapy work closely with our physios. Book online via the link in bio.
